title: Launch checklist and comms for Private/VPC RBAC, Audit Logging, and KMS integrations
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Purpose: Coordinate the cross-team launch of Private/VPC features: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), tenant-scoped Audit Logging, and KMS-backed key management. This ticket centralizes launch tasks: release notes, docs, enablement, GTM comms, and post-launch monitoring.

Scope: Public-facing release notes and SDK/API compatibility notes, Console enablement flows (RBAC role picker, audit log export), ops runbook for Private customers, security signoff checklist, partner enablement play for channel partners. Excludes multi-tenant architecture changes beyond RBAC auth layer (handled in ENG-2890).

Goals:
- Safe, auditable rollout for Private/VPC customers with KMS encryption and configurable RBAC roles.
- Clear release notes and per-feature migration guidance.
- Training materials and 1:1 onboarding checklist for Customer Success and Solutions Engineering.
- Monitoring and alerting for regressions post-launch (latency, auth errors, log delivery failures).
acceptance_criteria: Release notes drafted, reviewed by Legal and Security, and published to docs.redwood.ai/release/private-2026.04
Console feature flags for RBAC, Audit Logs, and KMS are gated and can be toggled per-customer
Customer-facing enablement doc + migration checklist published and linked in the Console
SRE and Observability have dashboards and SLOs for auth failures and log ingestion; alerts tested with runbook steps
Security review and KMS integration validated by SEC (ticket SEC-114) and signed off

risks: KMS key rotation edge case could invalidate tokens for short window — mitigation: staggered rotation + canary test
Audit log delivery retries causing increased egress for large tenants — mitigation: configurable retention and batching thresholds
RBAC misconfiguration could lock customer admins out — mitigation: emergency fallback roles and manual unlock procedure in runbook
Console copy errors might lead to incorrect customer expectations — mitigation: legal and UX review signoffs
notes_for_release_notes: Private/VPC: Role-Based Access Control — Add fine-grained roles to control who can configure models, view logs, and manage keys. Learn more: https://docs.redwood.ai/private/rbac
Private/VPC: Audit Logging — Tenant-scoped audit logs for all admin actions, exportable to customer S3 destinations and SIEMs.

Private/VPC: KMS Integration — Option to supply customer-managed keys (CMK) or use Redwood KMS; supports HSM-backed providers. See security note: https://confluence.redwood.ai/private/rbac-kms-audit/security
post_launch_monitoring: Authentication error rate (5xx and 401) — threshold: 0.5% over baseline — alert to SRE
Audit log ingestion latency — threshold: 99th percentile < 5s — alert to EngOps
KMS API error rate — threshold: 1% — alert to Security/Eng
Customer support tickets tagged 'private-rbac' — weekly report to PM and CS
